short: Rewarding existing customers for bringing new ones.
seoTitle: Referral Program — Meaning, Formula and Example
metaDescription: A referral program rewards existing customers for introducing new ones, usually with a benefit for both sides. Part of the free Setu business glossary.
definition: A referral program rewards existing customers for introducing new ones, usually with a benefit for both sides. It converts satisfaction into acquisition at a known cost.
bodyHtml:
Why Referral Program matters

Referred customers typically convert better, spend more and stay longer, because they arrive with a recommendation attached. The cost per acquisition is also fixed and known in advance.

Referral Program formula

Referral CAC = Total reward value paid ÷ New customers referred

Compare with paid channel CAC before scaling either.

How Referral Program works in practice

Make the reward worth mentioning, the mechanic simple, and the ask well timed — right after a good experience. Track referral CAC against paid channels to see which is genuinely cheaper.

faq.question: Should both sides be rewarded?
faq.answer: Usually yes. A two-sided reward removes the awkwardness of asking and gives the new customer a reason to act.

faq.question: How do I track referrals offline?
faq.answer: A unique code or the referring customer's phone number captured at billing.
